description: Zoom into screenshots, step through recordings and play audio in bb's right panel instead of a fit-only preview. Drag to pan, pinch or Ctrl-scroll to zoom at the pointer, and double-click to switch between Fit and a close-up. Previous and next step through every image, video and audio file in the same folder. Videos get frame stepping, seeking and speeds from 0.25× to 2×, and agents can show the same viewer inline in a reply with a ::media directive.
